title: Selangor Marathon 2026 Review: Tourism Selangor's Full Marathon in Cyberjaya
seo_title: Selangor Marathon 2026 Review | SELMAR Cyberjaya Malaysia
meta_description: The Selangor Marathon 2026 (SELMAR): November 1 at Persiaran Flora, Cyberjaya. Full and half marathon from Tourism Selangor with registration open.
dek: Set for 1 November 2026 at Persiaran Flora in Cyberjaya, this Tourism Selangor-organised marathon offers full and half distances with registration open. Malaysia's state-tourism-backed road race in the country's tech-city corridor.
verdict: The Selangor Marathon (SELMAR 2026) is a Tourism Selangor-backed full marathon in Cyberjaya — Malaysia's purpose-built tech city with wide roads and modern infrastructure. Two distances (42K, 21K) with registration open. Cyberjaya's wide boulevards and minimal density make for a fast, traffic-free course, and the November date in Selangor catches the inter-monsoon period with reasonable running conditions. A solid, state-government-backed Malaysian marathon with open registration.

sections.heading: Cyberjaya: Malaysia's Wide-Road Tech City
paragraphs: Cyberjaya's wide, well-maintained boulevards — designed for a planned tech city — provide an excellent marathon surface with minimal traffic.
